purpose: MinoMasal 31-100 video karakter kimligi referansi. Bu dosya tek basina video uretimini degistirmez.
visual_rules: Use the same character name, exact species or vehicle class, body structure, color palette, accessories and personality in every scene.
The named primary character must be clearly visible and visually identifiable in every scene where narration refers to them.
Do not invent new names or substitute species for mapped characters.
Include the full appearance_en description of every visible named character in each image prompt.
No lettering or watermarks in generated images. Do not rely on text labels to establish the character identity.
Preserve previously approved special-day JSON stories 33, 34, 45 and 46 unchanged.
A text-only character dictionary improves consistency but does not guarantee identical images; reference images and post-generation checks are recommended.

sincap.name: Sisi
sincap.appearance_en: A small russet squirrel with a fluffy curled tail, cream-colored chest, bright brown eyes, and a plain green neck scarf. Clearly recognizable squirrel anatomy.

tavsan.name: Ela
tavsan.appearance_en: A small light-brown rabbit with long upright white-tipped ears, warm brown eyes, a cream muzzle, and a plain blue neck scarf. Clearly recognizable rabbit anatomy.

fil.name: Edi
fil.appearance_en: A young light-gray elephant with a short flexible trunk, large ears with pink inner surfaces, expressive dark eyes, and a plain blue vest. Clearly recognizable elephant anatomy.

zurafa.name: Zeli
zurafa.appearance_en: A young golden-yellow giraffe with a very long neck, clear large brown patches, small ossicones, warm brown eyes, and a plain orange neck scarf. The long neck and giraffe body must be visible.

kedi.name: Misket
kedi.appearance_en: A small gray-and-white kitten with green eyes, pointed cat ears, soft whiskers, a long feline tail, and a plain purple neck scarf.

kirpi.name: Pıtır
kirpi.appearance_en: A small hedgehog with brown spines on its back, a cream-colored face, tiny paws, round dark eyes, and a plain red scarf.

penguen.name: Piko
penguen.appearance_en: A small black-and-white penguin with yellow feet, a short orange beak, round dark eyes, and a plain turquoise scarf. Distinctive penguin flippers.

aslan.name: Asil
aslan.appearance_en: A young lion with golden fur, a small deep-orange mane, green eyes, rounded lion ears, and a tufted lion tail.

panda.name: Pofi
panda.appearance_en: A small giant panda with black-and-white fur, black eye patches, a round face, short rounded ears, and a small yellow backpack.

serce.name: Cıvıl
serce.appearance_en: A little sparrow with light-brown wings and back, cream belly, a short yellow beak, small bird feet, and a tiny pink ribbon.

tilki.name: Tili
tilki.appearance_en: A small orange fox with pointed ears, white muzzle and tail tip, bright amber eyes, and a plain navy-blue vest.

koala.name: Koko
koala.appearance_en: A small gray koala with large fluffy round ears with pink inner fur, a prominent dark oval nose, round eyes, and a plain green neck scarf.

maymun.name: Momo
maymun.appearance_en: A small light-brown monkey with a cream face and belly, big dark eyes, a long curled monkey tail, and a plain red T-shirt.

baykus.name: Badi
baykus.appearance_en: A tawny-brown owl with large golden eyes, feathered ear tufts, a short hooked beak, brown-and-cream feathers, and a plain green vest; often the forest-school teacher.

ayi.name: Bobo
ayi.appearance_en: A small friendly honey-brown bear with rounded ears, a cream muzzle, kind dark eyes, and a plain red neck scarf.

ayicik.name: Balım
ayicik.appearance_en: A tiny light-brown bear cub with rounded ears, a cream snout, bright dark eyes, and a little sky-blue vest. Distinct from the older bear Bobo.
ayicik.personality_tr: Sevecen, zaman zaman kıskanç ama öğrenmeye açık.

kaplumbaga.name: Tosbi
kaplumbaga.appearance_en: A small turtle with light-green skin, a dark-green patterned shell, short legs, and large brown eyes.

ari.name: Mara
ari.appearance_en: A small friendly bee with clear yellow-and-black abdominal stripes, large blue eyes, two transparent wings, and short antennae. Clearly a bee, not another insect.

ejderha.name: Dogo
ejderha.appearance_en: A friendly small fantasy dragon with light-green scales, small orange wings, a pale blue belly, short rounded horns, and a long dragon tail; no fire or threatening features.

dinozor.name: Dino
dinozor.appearance_en: A small friendly green cartoon dinosaur with a rounded snout, short legs, a medium-length thick tail, lighter green belly, and gentle dark eyes. Clearly a dinosaur, not a dragon.

oyuncak_kamyon.name: Tonton
oyuncak_kamyon.appearance_en: A small blue toy dump truck with four black wheels, an open cargo bed, friendly windshield eyes, and a tiny silver front bumper. Clearly a truck.

itfaiye.name: Lava
itfaiye.appearance_en: A friendly bright-red fire engine with a silver roof ladder, white reflective stripes, four dark wheels, and expressive windshield eyes. Clearly recognizable fire truck.

yaris_arabasi.name: Rüzgâr
yaris_arabasi.appearance_en: A compact sporty race car with a bright red body, yellow racing accents, a low aerodynamic shape, four black racing tires, and expressive windshield eyes. No text or numbers.

traktor.name: Tora
traktor.appearance_en: A friendly green farm tractor with large rear black tires, smaller front tires, yellow wheel rims, a black exhaust pipe, and expressive windshield eyes.

cekici.name: Atlas
cekici.appearance_en: An orange tow truck with a visible rear towing hook and boom, four black wheels, a sturdy body, and expressive windshield eyes.

beton_mikseri.name: Miko
beton_mikseri.appearance_en: A white-and-orange concrete mixer truck with a large clearly visible rotating mixing drum, six dark wheels, and friendly windshield eyes.

otobus.name: Boni
otobus.appearance_en: A small sunshine-yellow city bus with large side windows, four black wheels, friendly windshield eyes, and rounded corners. Clearly recognizable bus.

oyuncak_tren.name: Tutu
oyuncak_tren.appearance_en: A small red-and-blue toy locomotive with a short chimney, a smiling front face, black train wheels, and two tiny matching carriages.

vinc.name: Vini
vinc.appearance_en: A compact golden-yellow mobile crane with a long raised boom and visible hook, four black wheels, and friendly cab eyes. Clearly a crane.

cop_kamyonu.name: Pako
cop_kamyonu.appearance_en: A bright-green garbage collection truck with an enclosed rear compactor body, four dark wheels, and friendly windshield eyes.

kucuk_araba.name: Minti
kucuk_araba.appearance_en: A small rounded sky-blue passenger car with four wheels, a compact hatchback body, friendly windshield eyes, and a simple silver grille.

ambulans.name: Şifa
ambulans.appearance_en: A friendly white ambulance with clear red emergency stripes, a red medical cross emblem, a roof emergency lightbar, and expressive windshield eyes.

elektrikli_otomobil.name: İvi
elektrikli_otomobil.appearance_en: A modern compact turquoise electric hatchback with sleek LED headlights, smooth closed front grille, four dark wheels, friendly windshield eyes, and a small charging port. No exhaust pipe.

ucak.name: Pırpır
ucak.appearance_en: A small light-blue-and-white propeller airplane with clearly visible wings, a front propeller, landing wheels, and expressive cockpit windshield eyes.

denizalti.name: Dalgıç
denizalti.appearance_en: A small friendly bright-yellow submarine with a rounded hull, circular blue porthole windows, a short periscope, and a smiling face near its front.

balon.name: Ponpon
balon.appearance_en: A small friendly red hot-air balloon with a rounded balloon envelope, tan wicker basket, simple smiling eyes on the envelope, and visible supporting ropes.

roket.name: Rokko
roket.appearance_en: A small friendly white rocket with red nose cone and fins, two circular blue windows, a safe non-threatening propulsion glow, and expressive eyes near the front.

robot.name: Bibo
robot.appearance_en: A small rounded friendly robot with a white-and-silver body, two blue digital eyes on a dark face screen, short articulated arms, and two compact legs. Consistent blue chest indicator.

bulut.name: Buli
bulut.appearance_en: A small fluffy white cartoon cloud with soft rounded edges, tiny rosy cheeks, two expressive eyes, and a gentle smile; floating above the landscape.

gokkusagi.name: Gökçe
gokkusagi.appearance_en: A bright friendly rainbow arch with seven distinct bands of red orange yellow green blue indigo and violet, small expressive eyes and a smile near its center.

yagmur_damlasi.name: Damla
yagmur_damlasi.appearance_en: A small shiny sky-blue teardrop-shaped water droplet with expressive eyes, a tiny smile, and translucent highlights.

cocuk_efe.name: Efe
cocuk_efe.appearance_en: A young boy about six years old with short chestnut-brown hair, warm brown eyes, a yellow rain jacket, navy trousers, and blue shoes.

cocuk_mert.name: Mert
cocuk_mert.appearance_en: A young boy about six years old with short black hair, dark brown eyes, a green hoodie, denim trousers, and white sneakers. Visually distinct from Efe.

astronot.name: Lina
astronot.appearance_en: A young girl astronaut with short dark-brown hair, dark eyes, a white spacesuit with turquoise trim, clear helmet visor and blue gloves.

notes_tr: Rüzgâr yarış arabasının adı; uçak için Pırpır kullanılır.
Pofi panda, Buli bulut; iki karakterin adı farklıdır.
Bobo ayı, Balım minik ayıcık olarak ayrı kimliklerdir.
33, 34, 45, 46 numaralı onaylı özel gün JSON dosyalarındaki karakterleri geriye dönük değiştirmeyin.
Görseller üretilmeden önce karakter adları ve türleri üretim aşamasında eşlenmelidir.
